description.en: The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

description.zh:
集群代理类型。取值：

- **service**：SDK集成。

- **cname**：反向代理。
description.en:
The proxy type of the hybrid cloud cluster. Valid values:

- **service**: SDK-based integration.

- **cname**: CNAME-based reverse proxy.
The name of the hybrid cloud node group that you want to query.

description.zh:
混合云节点组类型。取值：

- **protect**：防护。

- **control**：管控。

- **storage**：存储。

- **controlStorage**：管控＆存储。
description.en:
The type of the hybrid cloud node group. Valid values:

- **protect**: protection node group.

- **control**: control node group.

- **storage**: storage node group.

- **controlStorage**: control and storage node group.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页的行数。默认值为**10**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
